plan.disposition: mini-plan is advisory and freely skippable at small complexity (Override Classes); root-cause investigation via F-debug.md substituted for a plan on this bug-fix path

findings.finding: shared/scripts/tools/finalize_iterate.py's _update_compliance subprocess.run call was missing encoding="utf-8", unlike the other two fixed call sites, which is inconsistent and could let a UnicodeDecodeError be silently swallowed by the surrounding bare `except Exception`.
findings.suggestion: Add encoding="utf-8", errors="replace" to match the other two call sites. FIXED in this iterate; re-verified via test_finalize_iterate_capture_order.py and the full shared/tests suite.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: All three fixed call sites are now consistently hardened against subprocess I/O quirks. — finalize_security_compliance.py and compliance_runner.py set encoding="utf-8" but not errors="replace", unlike finalize_iterate.py after the code-review fix — a non-UTF-8 byte in the compliance subprocess's stdout would raise UnicodeDecodeError there instead of degrading gracefully. FIXED: added errors="replace" to both remaining sites; re-verified via the full test suites for both trees.

Claim under doubt: finalize_security_compliance.py's _run_update_compliance degrades gracefully on every failure, matching its own documented error-dict contract. — Unlike sys.executable (always present, starts instantly), `uv` is an external binary that can be absent (FileNotFoundError) or need a slow first-time venv sync (TimeoutExpired) — either would raise UNCAUGHT out of _run_update_compliance, unlike every other failure branch in that function. FIXED: wrapped the call in try/except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError) returning the same {"updated_reports": [], "error": ...} contract; added a new parametrized regression test (test_run_update_compliance_does_not_raise_when_uv_itself_fails) exercising both exception types, confirmed RED before the fix and GREEN after.

Claim under doubt: The original 30s subprocess timeout is adequate for the new uv-based dispatch. — A cold `uv` venv sync (first-ever resolve/install of jsonschema/pyyaml) or a lock-wait under concurrent sessions sharing the same plugin cache can plausibly exceed 30s, causing spurious TimeoutExpired failures that never existed under the old always-present sys.executable call. FIXED: bumped the timeout constant to 60s at all three sites, and the paired outer Stop-fallback timeout in generate_handoff_on_stop.py from 60s to 90s to preserve the 'outer strictly exceeds inner' invariant — re-verified via test_runconfig_timeout_invariant.py (red at 60/60, green at 60/90).

Claim under doubt: This iterate leaves nothing about compliance-update error diagnostics unaddressed. — Confirmed pre-existing, out-of-scope finding: compliance-update callers discard the subprocess's stdout JSON diagnostics on non-zero exit, making failures harder to debug. This predates the iterate and is not introduced or worsened by it. Not fixed here by decision — filed as a tracked follow-up instead: triage card trg-106aef51.
